text: dsh-balanced-search 是面向 DSH Web 的网页搜索与抓取插件。它注册 balanced_search 和 balanced_fetch 工具，并将 DSH 内置 web_search、web_fetch 路由到共享的 provider 池。六家服务按轮换顺序提供搜索和内容抓取，失败时切换到其他服务；搜索支持时间范围和结果数量，抓取可设长度上限与实时模式，也可通过 MCP stdio 使用。适合需要在 DSH 中搜索网页、获取页面正文或连接 MCP 客户端的场景。使用前需配置六家服务中至少一个 API key。

dsh-balanced-search adds web search and fetching to DSH. It registers two tools and routes built-in web tools through six rotating providers with failover. Search supports time filters; fetch supports live mode and a character cap. An MCP server is included. Configure one provider API key.

dsh-balanced-search 的功能「多服务网页搜索」：balanced_search 接收关键词或自然语言问题，可指定结果数量和时间范围，并返回标题、链接与摘要。
dsh-balanced-search 的功能「网页正文抓取」：balanced_fetch 接收 URL，可设置返回字符上限及实时抓取选项，返回页面标题与正文。
dsh-balanced-search 的功能「轮换与失败切换」：搜索和抓取共享六家服务组成的 provider 池；调用按轮换次序分配，失败时继续尝试其他服务。
dsh-balanced-search 的功能「内置搜索接管」：bundle 将 DSH 的 web_search 与 web_fetch 路由到插件注册的 balanced provider，使用同一组服务处理内置搜索和抓取。
dsh-balanced-search 使用前须知：搜索和抓取会把查询文本或目标 URL 发送给已配置的第三方 provider；需设置六种 API key 中至少一种。（见 index.js:172）
dsh-balanced-search 使用前须知：未设置 provider key 时，内置搜索与抓取会因 balanced provider 不可用而失败。（见 cordis.patch.yml:24-38）

text:
dsh-balanced-search README · Parameter Reference / 参数说明：- `query` (required / 必填): Search keyword or natural language question / 搜索关键词或自然语言问题
- `max_results`: 1–20, default 8 / 1–20，默认 8
- `time_range`: `day` / `week` / `month` / `year` (native for Tavily; Exa maps to `startPublishedDate`; Keenable maps to `published_after`; Firecrawl maps to a relative recency window (`tbs`); TinyFish maps to `recency_minutes`; AnySearch has **no** recency parameter at all, so it is skipped for time-filtered searches whenever a capable vendor is configured) / （Tavily 原生；Exa 映射为 `startPublishedDate`；Keenable 映射为 `published_after`；Firecrawl 映射为回溯时间窗口（`tbs`）；TinyFish 映射为 `recency_minutes`；AnySearch **完全没有** recency 参数，因此只要池子里有支持回溯的厂商，带时间过滤的搜索就不会发给它）
- `max_chars`: Maximum characters to return, default 30000, max 50000. AnySearch and TinyFish have no length parameter, so the cap is applied client-side (AnySearch's server already caps near 50k) / 抓取内容最大字符数，默认 30000，上限 50000。AnySearch 与 TinyFish 没有长度参数，截断在客户端完成（AnySearch 服务端正文本来就以约 50k 封顶）
- `live`: Fetch live from the source (bypass index/cache), default `false`. Honoured by Keenable, Exa, Firecrawl (`maxAge: 0` forces an origin re-scrape) and TinyFish

dsh-balanced-search README · Provider differences / 各家能力差异：| Provider | Search / 搜索 | Fetch / 抓取 | Notable limits / 需要注意 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Keenable | REST | REST | supports `time_range` and `live` / 支持时间范围与实时抓取 |
| Exa | REST | REST | supports `time_range` (`startPublishedDate`) and `live` / 支持时间范围与实时抓取 |
| Tavily | REST | REST | native `time_range`; no live control / 原生时间范围；无实时开关 |
| Firecrawl | REST | REST | both capabilities supported; fetch serves a cached copy up to 2 days old unless `live=true` (then `maxAge: 0`, slower and more failure-prone); free tier is capped at 10 req/min, so it is one pool member rather than the main engine; the only backend that reports the origin page's HTTP status (see below) / 搜索与抓取都支持；抓取默认走最长 2 天的缓存，`live=true` 时传 `maxAge: 0` 回源（更慢、更容易失败）；免费档硬限 10 req/min，因此它是池中的一员而非主力；也是唯一会返回原页面 HTTP 状态码的后端（见下） |
| AnySearch | REST | REST (`extract`) | hard caps `max_results` at 10 (silently truncates more) and has **no recency parameter**, so `time_range` searches skip it; `extract` takes exactly `{"url": …}`, returns ~50k chars of Markdown; search and `extract` share 1,000 requests/day / `max_results` 硬上限 10（超过静默截断）且**没有 recency 参数**，带 `time_range` 的搜索会跳过它；

text: dsh-balanced-search README · Free-tier parameter design / 免费档参数设计：Every default in the adapters is chosen so the pool stays inside the free plans and never spends quota on a parameter that does not change the answer. / 适配层的每个默认参数都以"不超免费额度、不为不改变结果的东西付费"为准。
section: Free-tier parameter design / 免费档参数设计

text:
dsh-balanced-search README · Free-tier parameter design / 免费档参数设计：| Vendor | Cost-safe choice / 成本安全的选择 | Why / 原因 |
|---|---|---|
| Keenable | one request per search or fetch, `realtime` mode, no extra options | a flat 100,000 requests/month: one call is one unit / 固定 100,000 请求/月，一次调用就是一个单位 |
| Exa | `type: auto`, 3,000-char text budget per result | the cheapest search type, and card snippets do not need whole pages / 最便宜的搜索类型；卡片摘要不需要整页正文 |
| Tavily | `advanced` depth kept on purpose | 2 credits/search buys materially better research results, and the cost is spread over six quotas / 2 credits/次换来更好的研究结果，且成本摊到六份额度上 |
| Firecrawl | no `scrapeOptions` on `/search`, `sources: ['web']`, caller's exact result count as `limit` | scraping each result would cost 1 credit per result on top of 2 credits per 10 results / 逐条抓取会在"2 credits / 10 条"之外再按条计费（每条 1 credit） |
| AnySearch | `max_results` clamped to 10 and **kept out of `time_range` searches** | the server silently truncates anything above 10, and there is no recency field at all — returning unfiltered results for a filtered request would silently break the caller's contract / 服务端对超过 10 条静默截断；而且根本没有 recency 字段——用未过滤结果冒充过滤结果会悄悄破坏调用方契约 |
section: Free-tier parameter design / 免费档参数设计

text:
dsh-balanced-search README · Free-tier parameter design / 免费档参数设计：- AnySearch's 1,000 requests/day is shared by search **and** extract, so every fetch spends the same budget as a search; that is another reason the vendor is one pool member rather than the workhorse. / AnySearch 的每日 1,000 次请求由 search **与** extract 共用，所以每次抓取消耗的额度和搜索一样——这也是它只做池中一员而非主力的原因。
- TinyFish's search and fetch allowances are counted separately (12,000 searches/day vs 1,000 URLs/day), and neither draws on a wallet balance. / TinyFish 的搜索与抓取额度分开计（12,000 次搜索/天 与 1,000 个 URL/天），两者都不扣 wallet 余额。
section: Free-tier parameter design / 免费档参数设计

text: dsh-balanced-search README · Free-tier parameter design / 免费档参数设计：Why a cooldown exists / 为什么需要 cooldown：a spent daily/monthly quota or a revoked key fails the same way on every rotation, so retrying it every Nth call only adds latency. `auth` failures park the vendor for 30 minutes, `quota` for 20 minutes (a daily plan may reset sooner, and the user may top up mid-session), and `rate` for 30 seconds. A cooldown never empties the pool — when everything is cooling down, all vendors are tried again. / 额度用尽或被吊销的 key 每次轮换都会以同样方式失败，每 N 次调用重试一次只会增加延迟。`auth` 失败停放 30 分钟、`quota` 停放 20 分钟（日额度可能更早重置，用户也可能中途充值）、`rate` 只停 30 秒。cooldown 不会让池子变空：全部在冷却时仍会重试所有厂商。
section: Free-tier parameter design / 免费档参数设计

text:
dsh-balanced-search README · Configuration Notes / 配置说明：- Change keys / 换 key：dsh plugin uses environment variables; MCP server uses `.env` or client `env` injection.
- Failover strategy / 轮换策略：`Balancer` (currently round-robin + failover; can be changed to weighted or health-aware). Search and fetch advance independent cursors, so a fetch does not shift the next search's starting provider. A failed vendor can also be parked briefly by kind — `auth` 30 min, `quota` 20 min, `rate` 30 s — so a dry or revoked key is not retried on every rotation; if every vendor is cooling down they are all tried anyway, so a cooldown never turns into "no provider configured". / 搜索与抓取各自独立推进游标，一次抓取不会改变下次搜索的起点。失败的厂商还会按类别被短暂停放——`auth` 30 分钟、`quota` 20 分钟、`rate` 30 秒——避免对着已耗尽或已吊销的 key 每次轮换都重试；全部都在冷却时会照常重试全池，所以 cooldown 不会变成"没有可用 provider"。
- `time_range` routing / 时间过滤路由：providers that cannot filter by recency (`supports_time_range = False`, currently AnySearch) are left out of a time-filtered search as long as at least one capable vendor is configured — returning unfiltered results for a filtered request would silently break the caller's contract.
